thesis: Round 17 factorial cell. Form: a MACD(10,30,9) signal-line crossover inside a 200-day SMA regime filter. Brackets: stop. This card is one cell of a pre-registered 8x2x3 grid whose only purpose is to measure whether strategy form, the regime filter and the bracket policy each change a result by more than this programme's own measured noise floor of 21.2 percentage points. It is not a proposal to trade anything. Every parameter is the textbook constant frozen in app.evolution.ruleforms before this round was conceived; nothing here was tuned, and the universe is the mechanically defined GICS sector ETF set rather than any thesis-picked list, so that stock selection cannot flatter a form. See strategy-program/ROUND-17-PLAN.md for the pre-registration, the five falsifiable predictions and the correction applied across all cells.
entry: macd_macd(10, 30, 9) crosses_above macd_signal(10, 30, 9) and close > sma(200)
